description:
Cast The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {3}.
When The Peregrine Dynamo enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Cadric's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Cadric's trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a nonlegendary token copy of The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the tapped Peregrine Dynamo, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the Peregrine Dynamo token by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Cadric's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
